description: Lost or stalled, escalated by design: the payer of KIK-1017 says the $56.00 clutch bag shows delivered in Eldoret but never reached them. Expected step-up SHIPMENT_DELIVERED: the carrier shows it delivered, so refund-delivered-claim asks the merchant first. The message is simulated. Illustrative people and orders.

messages.subject: KIK-1017 says delivered but I don't have it
messages.body:
Hello,

The tracking for my clutch bag, order KIK-1017, says it was delivered in Eldoret, but nothing came. I've asked my neighbours and the gate guard and nobody has seen it. Could you refund the $56.00?

Thank you.
